risks: A healer that holds may still run its offensive rotation (for example Smite) and spend mana on it. The strategy does not suppress healer offense.

The mixture hold trusts the 20,000 floor. A player above the floor but below 10,000 after an unprotected non-boss hit (a trash add on the composed route) is covered only because another engaged hostile lifts the hold.
The slime line (2 x 235,200 / living + 10,000) is a bot margin built from the native split and the round-3 per-member volley damage (up to ~43k). It is not a sourced value.
The Divine Plea and Mana Tide thresholds (85% and 75%) are bot policy. Divine Plea halves healing for 9 s, and the 10 s Massacre clearance keeps it off the floor window.
Tanks are ordinary members only while Feud is on the boss. An outage without Feud (never observed on a knockout) keeps the previous tank-first order.
